# Excel.CurrentWorkbook

## Syntax

    Excel.CurrentWorkbook() as table

## About

Returns the contents of the current Excel workbook. It returns tables, named ranges, and dynamic arrays. Unlike [`Excel.Workbook`](excel-workbook), it does not return sheets.
